غَادٌ A fresh, tender, juicy twig: (L:) and so غَادَةٌ applied to a tree (شَجَرَةٌ). (L, K.) ―
-b2- And the latter, A soft, or tender, goodly, thin-skinned, plump, and fresh, or flourishing, young woman: (L:) or, (S, A, L, K,) as also ↓ غَيْدَآءُ , (S, A, K,) a woman, soft, or tender: (S, A:) or soft, or tender, and limber (L, K, TA) in the sides. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
